fusions.name: Shell Cracker
fusions.desc: Cracks the target open for 4 damage, leaving it 6% easier to wound for 5 seconds, and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: From Every Plate
fusions.desc: Takes a helping from every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 26 damage to each and healing you for 25% of the damage dealt. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Passed Down the Table
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Midden Heap
fusions.desc: Every kill you make builds a stack on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you heal for 5% of your maximum health per stack (20% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
